fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2025-06-01, a cheque bearing a forged signature of the complainant for Rs. 8,00,000 was presented near Roja Park Main Street. The time of the incident was given as 14:40 on 2025-05-21. The complaint was lodged by Hemanth Murugan (9000000301). Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Pandian Thangaraj, using the number 9000000427. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00010, as the mobile number 9000000427 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Forged signature reportedly used to obtain payment.
fields.Keywords: forgery, forged signature, main street, afternoon, mobile number, suspect
